items.title: The preliminary search found only two records
items.whyItMatters: Two records cannot support a decision; the leads are unchecked.
items.opportunity: Run a full search in three databases with the librarian's help and check every lead.

items.title: Confounding by severity
items.whyItMatters: Sicker patients see more physicians; unadjusted estimates overstate the benefit.
items.opportunity: Include only studies that adjust for morbidity or prior use, and rate risk of bias on this domain.

items.title: Few studies change continuity on purpose
items.whyItMatters: The network's decision is an intervention, but most evidence is associational (claim c2).

items.title: Waiting time is rarely measured
items.whyItMatters: Longer waits are the cost of personal lists.
items.opportunity: Extract waits as a balancing outcome.

errorsFound: A lead labelled 'landmark' was treated by the model as established; it has not been retrieved or checked.
reevaluation: A full systematic review is justified, with severity adjustment as an inclusion requirement and intervention studies reported apart.
summary: Four gaps: thin preliminary evidence, severity confounding, few intervention studies, and unmeasured waits.
